author: teteumac
body:
Remove the `chargedMuEnergy`, `chargedMuEnergyFraction`, `n60` and `n90` histograms from JetTester, including their member declarations, initialization, booking and filling.

  The removal applies to all collections using the tester, including HLT and MiniAOD where applicable. The `muonEnergy` and `muonEnergyFraction` histograms are retained. The `chargedMuEnergyFraction()` calls
  used in PF/PAT jet selection are unchanged.

  Validation: `git diff --check` passed, and remaining symbol references were reviewed. Compilation, package tests and the RelVal execution chain were not rerun for this revision.
title: [RelVal] Remove obsolete histograms from JetTester - Round 1
